card.name: Eye and ear surgery text, linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'of' and 'semi' inside eye or ear procedure and anatomy descriptions, just before an anatomical structure is named.

modes.label: Linking words in eye surgery steps
modes.description: 'the' after a position word like from, around, with or over, before an eye structure such as limbus or pupil.
modes.example: Measure 4 millimeters inferotemporal from<< the>> limbus with the aid of calipers

modes.label: Of after degeneration
modes.description: 'of' in the phrase Wallerian degeneration of retinogeniculate fibers in statin warnings.

modes.description: 'semi' in semicircular canal in ear surgery text.
modes.example: Close the round window membrane and the lateral<< semi>>-circular canal with a fascia overlay
